official_policy:
1. Customers can request a return within 14 days of delivery.
2. The product must be unused and in its original packaging.
3. Final-sale items cannot be returned.
4. Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.
customer_question: I received my headphones 20 days ago. Can I return them and get a refund tomorrow?
draft_ai_reply: Yes, you can return the headphones within 30 days, even if they have been used. Every item is eligible, and your refund will arrive tomorrow.
